audit.whatIsWrong: Both chart layers read Olaf/Olaf/Olaf/Skill/Olaf/Skill/Olaf, but the packet levelChart is Olaf/Olaf/Olaf/Skill/Akali/Akali/Skill and the page's own whys[4], whys[5] and whys[6] describe Akali winning 6 and first item and a coinflip late.
audit.why: whys[4] 'her R... turning your engage into her kill window', whys[5] 'she edges the lane now', whys[6] 'a coinflip you must avoid'. The sides contradicted the prose on three rows.
audit.corrected: Rows 4, 5, 6 flipped to Akali, Akali, Skill in BOTH layers as one atomic group; rows 0-3 unchanged.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why sold level 6 as Olaf's window on the strength of 'Ragnarok deletes CC'. Perfect Execution (R, 120/90/60s) is a two-part dash with an execute — it applies no disable, so Ragnarok's immunity is irrelevant to it, and her ult is the larger spike.
audit.why: Riot text for Akali R: 'leaps in a direction... Re-cast: dashes in a direction, executing all enemies she strikes.' No CC component for Ragnarok to ignore. Ragnarok grants resists plus disable-immunity while attacking, 100/90/80s.
audit.corrected: Level 6 restated as hers; first-item stage rebuilt around her AP spike and Mercury's Treads.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[0] claims Twilight Shroud dodges 'your targeted E and your Q axe'. Undertow is thrown at a target location and damages enemies it passes through — it selects no unit, so the shroud does not stop it. Reckless Swing is unit-targeted and IS stopped.
audit.why: Riot text, Akali W: 'unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks'. Riot text, Olaf Q: 'throws an axe into the ground at a target location, dealing damage to enemies it passes through'. Location-targeted damage is not a selection.
audit.corrected: Shroud now described as blocking E only, with Q named as the tool that still reaches her inside it.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'W omnivamp' appears repeatedly. Olaf's W is Tough It Out: attack speed plus a shield, 16/15/14/13/12s, 50 mana. It has no lifesteal or omnivamp. His sustain is Berserker Rage (P), lifesteal scaling with missing health.
audit.why: Riot text, Olaf W: 'Olaf's Attack Speed is increased and he gains a Shield.' Riot text, Olaf P: 'gains Attack Speed and Life Steal based on his missing Health.' The mirror audit flagged the same retired-name problem.
audit.corrected: Named correctly in early, mid, whys[2] and wants.you[1].

edits.before: Ragnarok deletes CC — once you press R, nothing he has stops the run-down. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Akali's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Ragnarok's disable-immunity does nothing to Perfect Execution — that is a two-part dash and execute, not CC. Her 6 beats yours; trade on its cooldown.

edits.before: Sundered Sky is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Twilight Shroud's cooldown.
edits.after: Her first AP item lets her dash in, burst and Shroud before your 9s E returns — buy Mercury's Treads.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Akali carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Full-build Akali blinks past your Q and resets fights with R while you fall off — a coinflip. Close the game before this window arrives.

edits.before: Chained Q axe pickups perma-slow her into your E while W omnivamp heals her shuriken poke — a short all-in here is yours.
edits.after: Chained Q axe pickups perma-slow her into your E while Tough It Out shields the shuriken poke — a short all-in here is yours.

edits.before: Slow her with Q before she dashes and land E true damage while she has no Shroud charge
edits.after: Slow with Q — it passes through Shroud — and land E true damage before her 16s W is back

edits.before: Force short all-ins at Levels 2-3 where your passive attack speed and W omnivamp out-trade her energy poke
edits.after: Force short all-ins at Levels 2-3 where Berserker Rage lifesteal and the W shield out-trade her energy poke

edits.before: Drop W Twilight Shroud to dodge your targeted E and your Q axe, then poke with energy
edits.after: Drop W Twilight Shroud to dodge your targeted E; the Q axe still passes through her

edits.before: Akali has no Shroud charge wasted yet and her energy pool is shallow, so Levels 1-3 are yours. Land Q to slow her, walk up, and weave an auto plus E true damage — that point-blank nuke can't be dodged by her dash the way a skillshot can, and it eats her low early HP. Your passive ramps attack speed as you take her shuriken poke, and W omnivamp heals it back, so every short trade nets out in your favour. Just don't dump E onto a fresh Shroud — bait the W first.
edits.after: Akali has no Shroud charge wasted yet and her energy pool is shallow, so Levels 1-3 are yours. Land Q to slow her, walk up, and weave an auto plus E true damage — that point-blank nuke can't be dodged by her dash the way a skillshot can, and it eats her low early HP. Berserker Rage ramps attack speed and lifesteal as her shurikens chip you, and Tough It Out shields the rest, so every short trade nets out your way. Never dump E into a fresh Shroud — it cannot select her; bait the 16s W first.

edits.before: Through Levels 4-5 you still win the short all-in: chain Q axe pickups to perma-slow her so she can't kite, and her Shroud only buys her a few seconds before your W sustain and passive grind her down. Level 6 is where it flips — her R is a two-part dash that closes or escapes your range and finishes with an execute, and she can reset through Shroud, so a clean all-in becomes a coinflip. Respect her ult cooldown and trade on it being down.
edits.after: Through Levels 4-5 you still win the short all-in: chain Q axe pickups to perma-slow her so she can't kite, and Shroud only buys seconds — your Q still lands inside it while the W shield and passive lifesteal grind her down. Level 6 flips it: Perfect Execution is a two-part dash that closes or escapes and finishes with an execute, and Ragnarok's disable-immunity answers none of it. Trade only while her 120/90/60s R is down.

notes: The full layer repeats 'W-sustain' / 'W omnivamp' inside tradeGood, breakdown.trading, report[3].t and dosFull[1].d. Those strings are shared boilerplate across many Olaf matchups, so a per-matchup rewrite here would fight whatever the other slices do; recommend a single champion-level sweep replacing 'W-sustain' with 'shield off' across olaf's full layer. Olaf's kit file flags Undertow (Q) as 'grounding'; Riot's description says armour shred and slow only, so no grounding claim was made — noted also by the mirror.
